title: Reports Closed Incomplete and What a Withdrawal Releases
content:
A Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment carrying a damage report that was closed incomplete has part of a withdrawal's release retained.

- Where a damage report on the enrolment was closed incomplete in the twelve months before and money stands booked as owed to the host, the release is taken at the marketplace's incomplete-record share of 93 percent.
- Where such a report was closed incomplete in that period and no money stands booked as owed, it is taken at the marketplace's closed-record share of 96 percent.
- Where no report was closed incomplete in that period, nothing is retained on that account.

### How the reading falls

| Report closed incomplete in the twelve months before | Money standing booked as owed | Release taken at |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | some | 93 percent |
| one or more | none | 96 percent |
| none | either | the whole of it |

One report closed incomplete in the period is enough; the reports are not counted beyond the first.

### The record the reading is taken from

The reports counted are those standing on the damage report register for this enrolment within the twelve months before, a report being closed incomplete where it was closed for want of the evidence it needed.
